minutes.headline: Committee hired Rich Matthew as finance director and voted to request $300,000 free cash for the special education reserve.
minutes.summary: The committee interviewed and voted to hire a director of finance and operations, pending contract negotiation. It declared outdated literacy materials surplus, heard spring test results and fall reading screening data, and voted to request free cash for a special education reserve. It also discussed track and field drainage and wall costs, the Brooks House and the paraprofessional contract.

what_happened.line: The School Committee voted unanimously to hire a director of finance and operations, pending contract negotiations.
The committee voted unanimously to request free cash for the special education reserve fund, if certified at the November town meeting.
Members discussed funding the reserve with free cash given rising out-of-district placement costs, and noted overages on that line.
The committee voted to accept the new terms of the paraprofessional contract, unanimously.
Members heard that track and field drainage and wall work would come before the turf, and asked for a one-page timeline of project steps.

why_it_matters: The free cash request is a vote residents may be asked to take at the November town meeting, and it moves money from the town's year-end surplus toward a school reserve for placement costs that the district must meet.
The paraprofessional contract and the track and field work are both costs that will need to be funded in the school budget, and the minutes do not give the amounts.
watch_next: The November town meeting, where the free cash request for the special education reserve depends on certification.
